en.headline: Taxi driver dies after being hit while checking tyre in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: A 67-year-old taxi driver was killed early Sunday when a private car struck him from behind as he inspected a burst tyre on Wan Po Road near Hong Kong Velodrome Park.
body: Police received a report at about 5:40 a.m. on Sunday that a private car driven by a 35-year-old man had collided with a stationary taxi and a pedestrian on Wan Po Road towards Kowloon near Hong Kong Velodrome Park in Tseung Kwan O.

According to police, the taxi, carrying a passenger, had suffered a burst left rear tyre. The 67-year-old taxi driver had got out to check the vehicle when the private car, also carrying a passenger, struck him from behind. The driver was trapped between the two vehicles and was later freed by firefighters.

He was rushed unconscious to Tseung Kwan O Hospital and certified dead at 6:58 a.m. The private-car driver sustained minor injuries and was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving causing death. Both passengers were unhurt. Officers from the Traffic Kowloon East Special Investigation Team are investigating and have appealed for witnesses.

zh.headline: 將軍澳的士司機落車查爆胎遭撞斃 私家車男司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 周日凌晨一名67歲的士司機在環保大道因左後胎爆裂落車檢查時，被一輛私家車從後撞倒夾困，送院後不治，35歲私家車司機涉危險駕駛引致他人死亡被捕。
body: 警方周日凌晨約5時40分接獲報案，指一輛私家車在將軍澳環保大道往九龍方向近香港單車館公園對開，與一輛停在路旁的的士及一名行人相撞。
警方表示，該的士載有一名乘客，左後輪胎突然爆裂，67歲姓陳的士司機落車到車尾查看時，被一輛同載有乘客的私家車從後撞及。的士司機被困兩車之間，由消防員救出後昏迷送往將軍澳醫院，於上午6時58分證實死亡。
35歲私家車司機受輕傷，涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人死亡被捕，現正被扣留調查。兩車乘客均無恙。東九龍總區交通部特別調查隊正跟進案件，呼籲目擊人士致電3661 0262提供資料。
